_comment: What grows in the wildlands (docs/systems-wildlands-ground.md#flora). Baked into client/shared/wildlands-field.js by npm run wildlands:bake and read by client/shared/flora.js.
`form` is a growth form the renderer knows how to draw (FLORA_FORMS in client/shared/flora.js). `where` is the ground a species grows on, as relief biomes, each with a weight.
`wet` and `slope` are the moisture (0..1) and step (tier units per tile) it tolerates; it does best in the middle of each range. `patch` is how tightly it grows in stands (0 is evenly spread).
`density` is plants per tile on each kind of ground before moisture. `line` is what a walker reads; keep it to one plain sentence.

creosote.name: creosote
creosote.line: Creosote grows out here at even spacing, each bush keeping its distance from the next.

bursage.name: bursage
bursage.line: Low grey bursage covers the ground between the bigger bushes.

sagebrush.name: sagebrush
sagebrush.line: Silver sagebrush, and the smell of it when the wind turns.

rabbitbrush.name: rabbitbrush
rabbitbrush.line: Rabbitbrush along the dry channel, yellow on top.

saltbush.name: saltbush
saltbush.line: Saltbush on the edge of the flat. Nothing else wants the ground.

saguaro.name: saguaro
saguaro.line: Saguaros stand on the slope. Most of them are older than the war.

prickly_pear.name: prickly pear
prickly_pear.line: Prickly pear in clumps, the fruit gone purple.

cholla.name: cholla
cholla.line: A cholla stand. The joints break off at a touch and ride along in your boot.

barrel.name: barrel cactus
barrel.line: Barrel cactus wedged between the rocks, leaning south.

agave.name: agave
agave.line: Agave on the broken ground, every leaf ending in a spike.

yucca.name: yucca
yucca.line: Yucca stalks stand over the grass, white flowers at the top.

joshua.name: Joshua tree
joshua.line: Joshua trees out on the flat, every one of them pointing a different way.

ocotillo.name: ocotillo
ocotillo.line: Ocotillo canes on the hillside, red at the tips.

juniper.name: juniper
juniper.line: Twisted junipers, half of each one dead and the other half not bothered.

mesquite.name: mesquite
mesquite.line: Mesquite along the wash, where the roots can reach whatever water is left.

cottonwood.name: cottonwood
cottonwood.line: A cottonwood in the wash. There's water under here somewhere.

tamarisk.name: tamarisk
tamarisk.line: Tamarisk thickets in the channel, pink and drinking everything.

bunchgrass.name: bunchgrass
bunchgrass.line: Bunchgrass, knee high, moving in the wind.

wildflowers.name: wildflowers
wildflowers.line: Wildflowers in the grass, orange and purple, nobody's idea.

snag.name: dead tree
snag.line: A dead tree, still standing because nothing out here rots.

wildthorn.name: wildthorn
wildthorn.line: Grey-green thorn, taller than you, grown on purpose. Somebody waters it.

wirethorn.name: wirethorn
wirethorn.line: A wirethorn, cholla gone green and copper from eating the old cable runs.
